_about: End-to-end ride times used to scale the 2023 feed's running times, line by line. Each entry names feed stop_ids. The build scales running times (not the 20 s dwells) on every segment between `from` and `to`, in both directions and on every route that uses those segments, so short workings and branches match too. No segment goes faster than build.tmin allows. Trip start times stay as published, so headways are unchanged. `stops` is the number of stops Google counts (stations after the first). An entry with `hold` is skipped and the reason printed.
source_note: Google Maps transit directions with the departure set to Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 11:00, end to end in one direction, read by pranjal on 23 Nov 2026
